title: 骨科
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋骨折判讀與急症（開放性骨折、腔室症候群）、髖部骨折老年照護路徑、關節置換與運動醫學關節鏡、上下肢常見骨折、脊椎與小兒骨科、骨關節炎與關節感染、骨腫瘤紅旗，以及術後 VTE 預防、石膏照護與交班。
introEn: This library covers fracture reading and emergencies (open fractures, compartment syndrome), the older-adult hip fracture pathway, arthroplasty and sports arthroscopy, common upper and lower limb fractures, spine and paediatric orthopaedics, osteoarthritis and joint infection, bone tumour red flags, plus postoperative VTE prevention, cast care and handover.

procedures.title: 骨折描述與 X 光系統判讀
procedures.titleEn: Fracture description and systematic X-ray reading
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：32 歲男性，足球時摔倒，左前臂疼痛變形，急診 X 光待判讀。本單元教描述語言與判讀流程，不替代影像科正式報告。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 32-year-old man who fell playing football, painful deformed left forearm, X-rays awaiting review. Teaches description language and reading workflow; it does not replace a formal radiology report.

stages.title: 機轉與能量
stages.evidence: 跌倒手撐地，低能量；無其他受傷。
stages.evidenceEn: Fall on outstretched hand, low energy; no other injuries.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 記錄機轉與能量，低能量仍需檢查關節上下
choices.en: Record mechanism and energy; even low energy needs the joints above and below examined

stages.reason: 機轉提示骨折型態與合併傷；上下關節是常被遺漏的區域。
stages.reasonEn: Mechanism predicts pattern and associated injuries; joints above and below are commonly missed.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：合併的肘或腕損傷被漏診。
stages.pitfallEn: Associated elbow or wrist injuries get missed.

stages.title: 神經血管檢查
stages.evidence: 橈動脈可觸及；拇指背屈無力、虎口感覺減退。
stages.evidenceEn: Radial pulse present; weak thumb extension and reduced first web space sensation.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 橈神經（後骨間神經）功能異常，記錄並優先處理
choices.en: Radial (posterior interosseous) nerve dysfunction: document and prioritise

stages.reason: 復位前後的神經血管記錄是法律與臨床的基準；神經損傷改變處置急迫性。
stages.reasonEn: Neurovascular documentation before and after reduction is the clinical and legal baseline; nerve injury changes urgency.
stages.pitfall: 若未記錄：復位後的神經損傷無法歸因。
stages.pitfallEn: Undocumented, a post-reduction deficit cannot be attributed.

stages.title: 影像需求
stages.evidence: 急診只拍了前臂正位。
stages.evidenceEn: Only an AP forearm film was taken.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 需兩個垂直面觀並含上下關節
choices.en: Two orthogonal views including the joints above and below

stages.reason: 「二法則」：兩面觀、兩關節、必要時兩側/兩次；單一面觀漏掉移位與脫臼。
stages.reasonEn: The rule of twos: two views, two joints, two sides or two occasions when needed; a single view misses displacement and dislocation.
stages.pitfall: 若單面觀：Monteggia 或 Galeazzi 的脫臼被漏掉。
stages.pitfallEn: A single view misses the dislocation in Monteggia or Galeazzi injuries.

stages.title: ABCS 系統判讀
stages.evidence: 開始判讀 X 光。
stages.evidenceEn: Starting to read the film.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.en: Go straight to the fracture line

choices.zh: 依序：對位、骨、軟骨/關節、軟組織
choices.en: In order: alignment (A), bone (B), cartilage/joints (C), soft tissues (S)

stages.reason: 系統性判讀避免「滿意搜尋」—找到一處骨折就停止。
stages.reasonEn: A systematic read prevents satisfaction of search, stopping after the first fracture.
stages.pitfall: 若跳過：第二處骨折或脫臼被漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Skipping steps misses a second fracture or dislocation.

stages.title: 部位與型態
stages.evidence: 橈骨中段 1/3 橫形骨折；尺骨完整。
stages.evidenceEn: Transverse fracture of the middle third of the radius; ulna intact.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 描述部位型態，並檢查遠端橈尺關節
choices.en: Describe site and pattern and check the distal radioulnar joint (Galeazzi)

stages.reason: 單一前臂骨骨折需找另一骨的脫臼；橈骨幹骨折合併 DRUJ 脫臼即 Galeazzi。
stages.reasonEn: An isolated forearm bone fracture demands a search for dislocation of the other; radial shaft fracture with DRUJ disruption is a Galeazzi injury.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉 DRUJ：慢性不穩定與疼痛。
stages.pitfallEn: A missed DRUJ injury causes chronic instability and pain.

stages.title: 移位與角度描述
stages.evidence: 遠端骨片向背側移位 50%，頂點向掌側成角 20°。
stages.evidenceEn: Distal fragment displaced 50% dorsally with 20° apex-volar angulation.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 以遠端骨片相對近端描述移位，並註明頂點方向
choices.en: Describe displacement of the distal relative to the proximal fragment and state the apex direction

stages.reason: 標準語言：遠端相對近端的移位、成角以頂點方向、縮短與旋轉。
stages.reasonEn: Standard language: distal relative to proximal, angulation by apex direction, plus shortening and rotation.
stages.pitfall: 若描述混亂：電話交班時外科醫師誤判。
stages.pitfallEn: Confused description misleads the surgeon on the phone.

stages.title: 關節內與特殊徵象
stages.evidence: 另一病人：肘部 X 光後脂肪墊徵象，無明顯骨折線。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient: elbow film with a posterior fat pad sign and no visible fracture line.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 隱匿性骨折（成人橈骨頭/小兒髁上），依骨折處理
choices.en: Occult fracture (radial head in adults, supracondylar in children): treat as a fracture

stages.reason: 後脂肪墊徵象代表關節積血，幾乎等同骨折。
stages.reasonEn: A posterior fat pad sign means haemarthrosis and is nearly diagnostic of fracture.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：未固定的骨折移位。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, an unsplinted fracture displaces.

stages.title: 小兒骨折型態
stages.evidence: 另一病人 6 歲：橈骨遠端皮質隆起，無完整骨折線。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient aged 6: cortical bulge of the distal radius without a complete fracture line.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 隆起骨折（buckle），穩定，短期固定

stages.reason: 小兒骨骼可塑性造成隆起與青枝骨折；多為穩定，保守治療。
stages.reasonEn: Paediatric bone plasticity produces buckle and greenstick fractures, usually stable and treated conservatively.
stages.pitfall: 若過度治療：不必要的石膏與焦慮；若忽略：疼痛持續。
stages.pitfallEn: Over-treatment adds unnecessary casting; neglect prolongs pain.

stages.title: 結構化溝通
stages.evidence: 電話向骨科住院醫師報告。
stages.evidenceEn: Phoning the orthopaedic resident.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 年齡、機轉、開放與否、神經血管、部位、移位
choices.en: Age, mechanism, open/closed, neurovascular status, site, pattern, displacement, associated injuries

stages.reason: 完整結構化報告讓接收者決定急迫性與處置。
stages.reasonEn: A complete structured report lets the receiver judge urgency and plan.
stages.pitfall: 若資訊不全：開放性骨折或神經損傷被延誤。
stages.pitfallEn: Incomplete information delays open fractures and nerve injuries.

stages.title: 處置決策
stages.evidence: 成人移位橈骨幹骨折。
stages.evidenceEn: Displaced adult radial shaft fracture.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 成人前臂骨幹移位骨折多需手術固定，先夾板止痛
choices.en: Displaced adult forearm shaft fractures usually need operative fixation; splint and analgesia first

stages.reason: 前臂是「關節」，旋轉功能依賴解剖復位；成人骨幹骨折以鋼板固定為主。
stages.reasonEn: The forearm functions as a joint; rotation depends on anatomical reduction, so adult shaft fractures are plated.
stages.pitfall: 若石膏治療：畸形癒合與旋轉受限。
stages.pitfallEn: Casting leads to malunion and loss of rotation.

procedures.title: 開放性骨折處置（Gustilo 分級）
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：28 歲男性機車車禍，右脛骨中段開放性骨折，傷口 8 cm 伴污染與骨外露，足背脈搏可觸及。本情境教學流程與原則，不含抗生素劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 28-year-old motorcyclist with an open mid-shaft tibial fracture, 8 cm contaminated wound with exposed bone, palpable dorsalis pedis. Teaches workflow and principles; no antibiotic doses.

stages.title: 初級評估優先
stages.evidence: 傷口明顯；病人心跳 115。
stages.evidenceEn: Obvious wound; heart rate 115.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 先完成 ABC 與出血控制，再處理骨折
choices.en: Complete ABC and haemorrhage control before the fracture

stages.reason: 引人注目的傷口分散注意力；致命的是未被發現的胸腹出血。
stages.reasonEn: A dramatic wound distracts; what kills is undetected chest or abdominal bleeding.
stages.pitfall: 若被傷口吸引：隱匿出血被漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Distraction by the wound misses occult haemorrhage.

stages.title: 傷口評估與攝影
stages.evidence: 急診準備反覆掀開敷料讓每位醫師看。
stages.evidenceEn: The ED keeps lifting the dressing for every clinician.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 一次評估、拍照、覆蓋後不再反覆掀開
choices.en: Assess once, photograph, remove gross contamination, cover, and do not re-expose
Explore the wound in the ED

stages.reason: 反覆暴露增加院內菌污染；照片供團隊溝通。急診不探查傷口。
stages.reasonEn: Repeated exposure adds hospital flora; photographs serve communication. Wounds are not explored in the ED.
stages.pitfall: 若反覆掀開：深部感染率上升。
stages.pitfallEn: Repeated exposure raises deep infection rates.

stages.title: 抗生素與破傷風
stages.evidence: 到院 20 分鐘；尚未給藥。
stages.evidenceEn: 20 minutes since arrival; nothing given.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 立即靜脈抗生素（目標 1 小時內）與破傷風評估
choices.en: IV antibiotics now, ideally within an hour, plus tetanus assessment

stages.reason: 早期抗生素是降低感染最有力的措施之一；BOAST 建議盡早、1 小時內。
stages.reasonEn: Early antibiotics are among the strongest infection-reducing measures; BOAST advises as soon as possible and within an hour.
stages.pitfall: 若延遲：深部感染與骨髓炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay leads to deep infection and osteomyelitis.

stages.title: Gustilo 分級
stages.evidence: 8 cm 污染傷口、骨膜廣泛剝離、預期需皮瓣覆蓋、血管完整。
stages.evidenceEn: 8 cm contaminated wound, extensive periosteal stripping, flap likely needed, vessels intact.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?
stages.reason: IIIA 軟組織可覆蓋、IIIB 需皮瓣、IIIC 合併需修補的動脈損傷；分級於清創時最終決定。
stages.reasonEn: IIIA has adequate coverage, IIIB needs a flap, IIIC has an arterial injury needing repair; final grading is made at debridement.
stages.pitfall: 若低估：覆蓋與整形團隊未被及早納入。
stages.pitfallEn: Underestimation delays involving the plastic surgery team.

stages.title: 血管評估
stages.evidence: 足背脈搏可觸及但較弱；足部溫暖。
stages.evidenceEn: Dorsalis pedis palpable but weaker; warm foot.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 測 ABI/都卜勒，<0.9 或不對稱則 CTA
choices.en: Check ABI/Doppler; below 0.9 or asymmetric warrants CTA

stages.reason: 可觸及的脈搏不排除動脈損傷；客觀測量分流誰需要影像。
stages.reasonEn: A palpable pulse does not exclude arterial injury; objective measurement triages who needs imaging.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉：IIIC 延誤血運重建，截肢。
stages.pitfallEn: A missed IIIC delays revascularisation and costs the limb.

stages.title: 敷料與夾板
stages.evidence: 準備轉送影像。
stages.evidenceEn: Preparing for imaging.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 生理食鹽水濕敷覆蓋，夾板固定並再次檢查神經血管
choices.en: Saline-soaked dressing, splint, and recheck neurovascular status

stages.reason: 夾板減少疼痛、出血與進一步軟組織損傷；固定後再評估神經血管。
stages.reasonEn: Splinting reduces pain, bleeding and further soft-tissue damage; neurovascular status is rechecked afterwards.
stages.pitfall: 若未固定：骨端刺傷血管神經。
stages.pitfallEn: Unsplinted bone ends injure vessels and nerves.

stages.title: 清創時機
stages.evidence: 污染傷口、高能量；現在凌晨 2 點。
stages.evidenceEn: Contaminated high-energy wound; it is 2 a.m.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 高能量污染 12 小時內清創；血管損傷則立即
choices.en: High-energy contaminated wounds: debridement within 12 hours by a senior team; gross contamination or vascular injury immediately

stages.reason: BOAST：高度污染/血管損傷立即；高能量 12 小時內；其他 24 小時內。資深團隊優於深夜匆忙。
stages.reasonEn: BOAST: immediate for gross contamination or vascular injury; within 12 hours for high energy; within 24 hours otherwise. A senior team beats a rushed night case.
stages.pitfall: 若延誤超過時限：感染與不癒合。
stages.pitfallEn: Exceeding the window raises infection and nonunion.

stages.title: 清創與沖洗
stages.evidence: 手術中：失活肌肉與污染骨片。
stages.evidenceEn: In theatre: devitalised muscle and contaminated bone fragments.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 切除失活組織與游離骨片，低壓食鹽水沖洗
choices.en: Excise devitalised tissue and fragments without soft-tissue attachment; low-pressure saline irrigation

stages.reason: 徹底清創是感染控制核心；FLOW 試驗顯示低壓生理食鹽水即可。
stages.reasonEn: Thorough debridement is the core of infection control; the FLOW trial showed low-pressure saline suffices.
stages.pitfall: 若保留死骨：慢性骨髓炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Retained dead bone becomes chronic osteomyelitis.

stages.title: 骨固定策略
stages.evidence: 清創後傷口乾淨；需覆蓋皮瓣。
stages.evidenceEn: Clean after debridement; flap needed.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 穩定固定（髓內釘或外固定）配合覆蓋計畫
choices.en: Stable fixation (nail or external fixator) coordinated with the coverage plan

stages.reason: 穩定降低感染與促進軟組織癒合；固定方式依污染程度與覆蓋時程。
stages.reasonEn: Stability lowers infection and aids soft-tissue healing; the method depends on contamination and coverage timing.
stages.pitfall: 若不穩定：軟組織反覆損傷與感染。
stages.pitfallEn: Instability re-injures soft tissue and infects.

stages.title: 軟組織覆蓋
stages.evidence: 骨外露；整形外科詢問時程。
stages.evidenceEn: Exposed bone; plastic surgery asks about timing.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 骨與整形共同於 72 小時內完成確定性覆蓋
choices.en: Combined ortho-plastic definitive coverage within 72 hours

stages.reason: 早期覆蓋（72 小時內）顯著降低深部感染；需帶血管皮瓣覆蓋骨外露。
stages.reasonEn: Early coverage within 72 hours markedly reduces deep infection; exposed bone needs a vascularised flap.
stages.pitfall: 若延遲：骨乾燥壞死與感染。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay desiccates bone with necrosis and infection.

stages.title: 追蹤與併發症
stages.evidence: 6 個月 X 光：骨折線仍清楚，無骨痂。
stages.evidenceEn: Six months: fracture line still clear, no callus.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 不癒合評估：感染排除、固定穩定性、植骨或更換固定
choices.en: Nonunion work-up: exclude infection, assess stability, consider grafting or revision fixation

stages.reason: 開放性脛骨骨折不癒合常見；感染性不癒合需先控制感染。
stages.reasonEn: Nonunion is common after open tibial fractures; infected nonunion needs infection control first.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略感染：植骨失敗。
stages.pitfallEn: Grafting into infection fails.

procedures.title: 骨筋膜室症候群的辨識與筋膜切開
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：24 歲男性，閉鎖性脛骨幹骨折髓內釘術後 8 小時，疼痛持續加劇且止痛需求上升。本情境教學辨識與原則，不含壓力測量器材設定。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 24-year-old man 8 hours after intramedullary nailing of a closed tibial shaft fracture, escalating pain and rising analgesic demand. Teaches recognition and principles; no pressure-device settings.

stages.title: 高風險情境
stages.evidence: 脛骨幹骨折、年輕男性、髓內釘術後。
stages.evidenceEn: Tibial shaft fracture, young man, after nailing.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 最高風險族群，需規律評估

stages.reason: 脛骨骨折（尤其年輕男性、高能量）是最常見原因；手術本身不排除。
stages.reasonEn: Tibial fractures, especially in young men after high energy, are the commonest cause; surgery does not exclude it.
stages.pitfall: 若無規律評估：夜間發生而未被察覺。
stages.pitfallEn: Without scheduled checks it develops unnoticed overnight.

stages.title: 臨床徵象
stages.evidence: 疼痛與傷害不成比例、被動伸展腳趾劇痛、小腿緊繃；足背脈搏可觸及。
stages.evidenceEn: Pain out of proportion, severe pain on passive toe stretch, tense calf; dorsalis pedis palpable.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 早期腔室症候群的典型徵象

stages.reason: 疼痛與被動伸展痛是最早徵象；無脈與麻痺是晚期，等到才切開已太遲。
stages.reasonEn: Pain and passive-stretch pain come first; pulselessness and paralysis are late and waiting for them is too late.
stages.pitfall: 若等晚期徵象：肌肉壞死不可逆。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting for late signs means irreversible muscle necrosis.

stages.title: 止痛需求趨勢
stages.evidence: 護理紀錄：止痛藥需求 4 小時內倍增。
stages.evidenceEn: Nursing chart: analgesic requirement doubled in 4 hours.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 視為警訊，立即床邊評估
choices.en: Treat as a warning sign; assess at the bedside now

stages.reason: 升高的止痛需求是客觀早期指標；區域麻醉可能掩蓋徵象。
stages.reasonEn: Rising analgesic demand is an objective early marker; regional anaesthesia can mask signs.
stages.pitfall: 若只加藥：徵象被掩蓋，延誤。
stages.pitfallEn: Simply escalating analgesia masks the signs and delays diagnosis.

stages.title: 移除壓迫
stages.evidence: 小腿有環狀彈性繃帶與夾板。
stages.evidenceEn: Circumferential bandage and splint in place.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 立即拆除所有環狀敷料與夾板至皮膚
choices.en: Remove all circumferential dressings and splints down to skin at once

stages.reason: 外在壓迫加重腔室壓力；拆除是最快的減壓步驟。
stages.reasonEn: External constriction adds to compartment pressure; removal is the fastest decompression.
stages.pitfall: 若保留：壓力持續上升。
stages.pitfallEn: Retained constriction keeps pressure rising.

stages.title: 肢體位置
stages.evidence: 護理師將患肢高抬以消腫。
stages.evidenceEn: The nurse elevates the limb to reduce swelling.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 置於心臟高度，不可高抬
choices.en: Keep at heart level, not elevated

stages.reason: 高抬降低動脈灌注壓，縮小灌注壓與腔室壓的差距。
stages.reasonEn: Elevation lowers arterial perfusion pressure and narrows the margin between perfusion and compartment pressure.
stages.pitfall: 若高抬：缺血惡化。
stages.pitfallEn: Elevation worsens ischaemia.

stages.title: 壓力測量的角色
stages.evidence: 臨床徵象明確；住院醫師想先測壓力確認。
stages.evidenceEn: Signs are clear; the resident wants a pressure reading first.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 臨床診斷明確即切開；測壓用於意識不清或徵象不確定者
choices.en: Clear clinical diagnosis goes to fasciotomy; measure pressure in obtunded patients or equivocal cases

stages.reason: 腔室症候群是臨床診斷；ΔP（舒張壓−腔室壓）<30 mmHg 支持切開，用於無法評估者。
stages.reasonEn: Compartment syndrome is a clinical diagnosis; a delta P (diastolic minus compartment) under 30 mmHg supports release in patients who cannot be assessed.
stages.pitfall: 若等待測量：延誤切開。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting for measurement delays release.

stages.title: 筋膜切開決策
stages.evidence: 診斷確立；手術室 1 小時後有空。
stages.evidenceEn: Diagnosis made; theatre free in an hour.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 緊急，於數小時內（目標 1 小時）切開
choices.en: Emergency: release within hours, ideally within one

stages.reason: 肌肉缺血 4–6 小時後開始不可逆；延誤每小時都在失去功能。
stages.reasonEn: Muscle becomes irreversibly damaged after 4-6 hours of ischaemia; every hour of delay loses function.
stages.pitfall: 若延誤：Volkmann 攣縮、垂足、截肢。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay causes Volkmann's contracture, foot drop or amputation.

stages.title: 四腔室切開原則
stages.evidence: 小腿筋膜切開。
stages.evidenceEn: Leg fasciotomy.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 雙切口完整釋放前、外、淺後、深後四腔室
choices.en: Two incisions releasing anterior, lateral, superficial and deep posterior compartments fully

stages.reason: 深後腔室最常被遺漏；不完整切開等於未治療。
stages.reasonEn: The deep posterior compartment is most often missed; incomplete release equals no treatment.
stages.pitfall: 若遺漏深後：脛後神經與屈趾肌壞死。
stages.pitfallEn: Missing the deep posterior compartment kills the tibial nerve and toe flexors.

stages.title: 傷口與延遲閉合
stages.evidence: 切開後肌肉膨出，傷口無法一期關閉。
stages.evidenceEn: Muscle bulges after release; primary closure impossible.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 開放傷口，48–72 小時後再評估閉合或植皮
choices.en: Leave open with dressing or negative pressure; reassess at 48-72 hours for staged closure or graft

stages.reason: 強行關閉重建腔室症候群；延遲閉合是標準。
stages.reasonEn: Forcing closure recreates the compartment syndrome; delayed closure is standard.
stages.pitfall: 若強行關閉：再次缺血。
stages.pitfallEn: Forced closure causes recurrent ischaemia.

stages.title: 後續監測
stages.evidence: 術後尿液深褐色、CK 升高。
stages.evidenceEn: Dark urine and raised CK postoperatively.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 橫紋肌溶解：輸液與腎功能監測，評估電解質
choices.en: Rhabdomyolysis: fluids, renal monitoring and electrolyte review

stages.reason: 缺血再灌注釋放肌紅蛋白；腎損傷可預防。
stages.reasonEn: Ischaemia-reperfusion releases myoglobin; kidney injury is preventable.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：急性腎損傷與高鉀。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, AKI and hyperkalaemia follow.

procedures.title: 髖部骨折老年照護路徑
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：84 歲女性，在家跌倒，右髖疼痛無法負重，X 光示移位性股骨頸骨折；失智早期、服用 apixaban。本單元教路徑與決策，不替代機構規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 84-year-old woman who fell at home, painful right hip unable to bear weight, X-ray showing a displaced femoral neck fracture; early dementia, on apixaban. Teaches the pathway and decisions; it does not replace institutional protocols.

stages.title: 急診評估
stages.evidence: 疼痛劇烈、右下肢外旋縮短；尚未止痛。
stages.evidenceEn: Severe pain, right leg shortened and externally rotated; no analgesia yet.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 立即評估疼痛並給止痛，同時排除其他傷害與原因
choices.en: Assess and treat pain immediately while excluding other injuries and causes of the fall

stages.reason: 疼痛控制是路徑第一步；跌倒原因（心律、藥物）同樣需要評估。
stages.reasonEn: Pain control is the first step of the pathway; the cause of the fall (arrhythmia, drugs) also needs evaluation.
stages.pitfall: 若止痛延誤：譫妄與壓瘡風險上升。
stages.pitfallEn: Delayed analgesia raises delirium and pressure injury risk.

stages.title: 神經阻斷
stages.evidence: 口服止痛不足，病人高齡。
stages.evidenceEn: Oral analgesia insufficient in a frail patient.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 髂筋膜或股神經阻斷作為多模式止痛的一部分
choices.en: Fascia iliaca or femoral nerve block as part of multimodal analgesia

stages.reason: 區域阻斷減少鴉片類需求與譫妄，是指引建議的常規。
stages.reasonEn: Regional blocks reduce opioid need and delirium and are recommended routinely.
stages.pitfall: 若依賴鴉片類：呼吸抑制與譫妄。
stages.pitfallEn: Opioid reliance causes respiratory depression and delirium.

stages.title: 影像與分類
stages.evidence: X 光：囊內、移位（Garden IV）。
stages.evidenceEn: X-ray: intracapsular, displaced (Garden IV).
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 移位性囊內骨折，股骨頭血供受威脅
choices.en: Displaced intracapsular fracture with threatened femoral head blood supply

stages.reason: 囊內移位骨折的股骨頭血供受損，老年人以關節置換為主；MRI 僅用於 X 光陰性但高度懷疑者。
stages.reasonEn: Displaced intracapsular fractures compromise the head's blood supply, so older patients get arthroplasty; MRI is for X-ray-negative suspected fractures.
stages.pitfall: 若分類錯誤：術式錯誤，固定失敗。
stages.pitfallEn: Misclassification chooses the wrong operation and fixation fails.

stages.title: 抗凝與術前最佳化
stages.evidence: 服用 apixaban；最後一劑 6 小時前；腎功能正常。
stages.evidenceEn: On apixaban, last dose 6 hours ago, normal renal function.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 依規範間隔後手術（多在 24–48 小時內）
choices.en: Operate after the protocol interval from the last dose (usually within 24-48 hours), without open-ended delay

stages.reason: DOAC 的延遲應最小化；延後手術的死亡率代價高於出血風險。
stages.reasonEn: DOAC-related delay should be minimised; the mortality cost of delay exceeds the bleeding risk.
stages.pitfall: 若無限延後：肺炎、壓瘡與死亡率上升。
stages.pitfallEn: Open-ended delay raises pneumonia, pressure injury and mortality.

stages.title: 手術時機
stages.evidence: 病人穩定；手術室排程在 3 天後。
stages.evidenceEn: Stable; theatre lists the case in 3 days.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 目標入院當日或次日（36–48 小時內）手術
choices.en: Target surgery on the day of or the day after admission (within 36-48 hours)

stages.reason: 早期手術減少疼痛、併發症與死亡；不應為非必要檢查延後。
stages.reasonEn: Early surgery reduces pain, complications and mortality; non-essential tests must not delay it.
stages.pitfall: 若延後：每延遲一天死亡率上升。
stages.pitfallEn: Each day of delay increases mortality.

stages.title: 術式選擇
stages.evidence: 移位囊內骨折；病人術前需助行器、早期失智。
stages.evidenceEn: Displaced intracapsular fracture; walker-dependent, early dementia.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?
stages.reason: 全髖保留給能獨立行走、認知正常的病人；其餘以骨水泥半髖；移位骨折在老年人不做固定。
stages.reasonEn: THA is for independently mobile, cognitively intact patients; others get cemented hemiarthroplasty; fixation is not used for displaced fractures in the elderly.
stages.pitfall: 若固定移位骨折：不癒合與股骨頭壞死，再手術。
stages.pitfallEn: Fixing a displaced fracture leads to nonunion and avascular necrosis with reoperation.

stages.title: 老年醫學共同照護
stages.evidence: 病人多重用藥、低鈉。
stages.evidenceEn: Polypharmacy and hyponatraemia.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 老年醫學團隊入院即介入評估與最佳化
choices.en: Orthogeriatric team involved from admission for assessment and optimisation

stages.reason: 共同照護降低死亡率與住院日，是 NICE 與 NHFD 的核心標準。
stages.reasonEn: Co-management lowers mortality and length of stay and is a core NICE/NHFD standard.
stages.pitfall: 若無：藥物與內科問題延誤手術與復原。
stages.pitfallEn: Without it, medical issues delay surgery and recovery.

stages.title: 譫妄預防
stages.evidence: 術後第 1 天夜間混亂、拔點滴。
stages.evidenceEn: Night 1: confused, pulling lines.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 找誘因（疼痛、尿滯留、缺氧、藥物），非藥物措施優先
choices.en: Search for causes (pain, retention, hypoxia, drugs); non-pharmacological measures first

stages.reason: 譫妄是可預防與可逆的；鎮靜與約束反而惡化。
stages.reasonEn: Delirium is preventable and reversible; sedation and restraint worsen it.
stages.pitfall: 若鎮靜：跌倒、吸入與延長住院。
stages.pitfallEn: Sedation leads to falls, aspiration and longer stay.

stages.title: 早期活動
stages.evidence: 術後第 1 天；物理治療詢問負重。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 1; physiotherapy asks about weight bearing.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 術後次日起可耐受負重並開始活動
choices.en: Weight bearing as tolerated and mobilisation from the day after surgery

stages.reason: 手術應允許立即全負重；早期活動減少肺炎、血栓與功能喪失。
stages.reasonEn: Surgery should permit immediate full weight bearing; early mobilisation reduces pneumonia, thrombosis and functional loss.
stages.pitfall: 若臥床：肺炎、壓瘡與永久失能。
stages.pitfallEn: Bed rest causes pneumonia, pressure injuries and permanent disability.

stages.title: 骨鬆與跌倒預防
stages.evidence: 出院前；未討論骨質疏鬆。
stages.evidenceEn: Before discharge; osteoporosis not addressed.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 髖部骨折即為脆弱性骨折，啟動抗骨鬆治療與跌倒評估
choices.en: A hip fracture is a fragility fracture: start bone protection and falls assessment

stages.reason: 髖部骨折後再骨折風險高；治療不需等 DXA。
stages.reasonEn: Refracture risk is high after hip fracture; treatment need not wait for DXA.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：對側髖骨折。
stages.pitfallEn: Neglect leads to a contralateral hip fracture.

stages.title: 出院規劃
stages.evidence: 病人術後第 5 天可助行器行走 20 公尺。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 5: walks 20 m with a frame.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 多專科評估居家安全、復健與照護需求後出院
choices.en: Multidisciplinary assessment of home safety, rehab and care needs before discharge

stages.reason: 功能恢復與居家安全決定出院去向；早期規劃縮短住院。
stages.reasonEn: Functional recovery and home safety decide the destination; early planning shortens stay.
stages.pitfall: 若倉促：再跌倒與再入院。
stages.pitfallEn: Rushed discharge leads to another fall and readmission.

procedures.title: 股骨頸骨折半髖置換
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：84 歲女性，移位性股骨頸骨折，計畫骨水泥半髖置換。本單元教步驟與安全，不含植入物尺寸或骨水泥技術參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 84-year-old woman with a displaced femoral neck fracture planned for cemented hemiarthroplasty. Teaches steps and safety; no implant sizes or cementing parameters.

procedures.title: 轉子間骨折髓內釘固定
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：79 歲男性，跌倒後左側不穩定型轉子間骨折（反斜型），計畫頭髓內釘固定。本單元教步驟與安全，不含植入物規格。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 79-year-old man with an unstable left intertrochanteric fracture (reverse oblique) planned for cephalomedullary nailing. Teaches steps and safety; no implant specifications.

procedures.title: 全髖關節置換步驟
procedures.titleEn: Total hip arthroplasty step by step
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：66 歲女性，右髖末期骨關節炎，夜間痛與行走 200 公尺受限，保守治療無效，BMI 29。本單元教步驟與決策，不含植入物規格。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 66-year-old woman with end-stage right hip osteoarthritis, night pain and walking limited to 200 m despite conservative care, BMI 29. Teaches steps and decisions; no implant specifications.

procedures.title: 全膝關節置換步驟
procedures.titleEn: Total knee arthroplasty step by step
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：70 歲男性，右膝內翻 10° 末期骨關節炎，注射與物理治療無效，BMI 31。本單元教步驟與決策，不含截骨角度以外的植入物參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 70-year-old man with end-stage right knee OA in 10° varus, failed injections and physiotherapy, BMI 31. Teaches steps and decisions; no implant parameters beyond published alignment principles.

procedures.title: 前十字韌帶損傷評估與重建
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：23 歲女性足球員，轉身時膝部「啪」聲後腫脹，Lachman 陽性，MRI 證實 ACL 完全斷裂併內側半月板撕裂。本單元教決策與步驟，不含隧道尺寸。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 23-year-old female footballer, pop on pivoting with swelling, positive Lachman, MRI confirming complete ACL rupture with a medial meniscal tear. Teaches decisions and steps; no tunnel sizes.

procedures.title: 半月板損傷與膝關節鏡
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：19 歲男性，籃球扭傷後膝關節卡住無法完全伸直，MRI 示內側半月板桶柄狀撕裂移位。本單元教決策與步驟，不含器械參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 19-year-old basketball player, locked knee unable to fully extend after a twisting injury, MRI showing a displaced bucket-handle medial meniscal tear. Teaches decisions and steps; no instrument parameters.

關節鏡入口與系統檢查

procedures.title: 肩旋轉袖撕裂評估與關節鏡修補
procedures.titleEn: Rotator cuff tear assessment and arthroscopic repair
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：56 歲男性，搬重物後右肩疼痛無力 3 個月，夜間痛，外展無力，MRI 示棘上肌全層撕裂回縮 2 cm、脂肪浸潤輕微。本單元教決策與步驟，不含錨釘規格。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 56-year-old man with 3 months of right shoulder pain and weakness after lifting, night pain, weak abduction, MRI showing a full-thickness supraspinatus tear retracted 2 cm with mild fatty infiltration. Teaches decisions and steps; no anchor specifications.

procedures.title: 肩關節脫臼復位
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：21 歲男性，橄欖球撞擊後右肩疼痛變形、手臂外展外旋位固定。本情境教學流程與安全，不含鎮靜劑量或手法施力。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 21-year-old rugby player with a painful deformed right shoulder held in abduction and external rotation after a tackle. Teaches workflow and safety; no sedation doses or force parameters.

procedures.title: 橈骨遠端骨折復位與固定
procedures.titleEn: Distal radius fracture reduction and fixation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：62 歲女性，跌倒手撐地，右腕餐叉狀變形，X 光示關節外背側移位骨折。本單元教流程與決策，不含麻醉劑量或鋼板規格。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 62-year-old woman after a fall on the outstretched hand, dinner-fork deformity, extra-articular dorsally displaced fracture. Teaches workflow and decisions; no anaesthetic doses or plate specifications.

procedures.title: 腕舟骨骨折：診斷陷阱與處置
procedures.titleEn: Scaphoid fracture: diagnostic pitfalls and management
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：25 歲男性，滑板跌倒手撐地，解剖鼻煙壺壓痛，初次 X 光未見骨折。本單元教診斷流程與決策，不含螺釘規格。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 25-year-old skateboarder after a fall on the outstretched hand, anatomical snuffbox tenderness, initial X-rays negative. Teaches the diagnostic pathway and decisions; no screw specifications.

procedures.title: 踝關節骨折評估與 ORIF
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：38 歲女性，踩空扭傷，右踝 Weber B 腓骨骨折併內側壓痛與距骨外移，皮膚腫脹起水泡。本單元教流程與決策，不含植入物規格。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 38-year-old woman after a misstep, right Weber B fibular fracture with medial tenderness and talar shift, swollen skin with blisters. Teaches workflow and decisions; no implant specifications.

procedures.title: 阿基里斯腱斷裂
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：41 歲男性，羽球起跳時小腿後方「被踢到」感，無法踮腳，Thompson 測試陽性。本單元教決策與流程，不含縫合參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 41-year-old badminton player felt "kicked" in the calf on push-off, cannot tiptoe, positive Thompson test. Teaches decisions and workflow; no suture parameters.

procedures.title: 骨質疏鬆性脊椎壓迫性骨折與椎體成形概念
procedures.titleEn: Osteoporotic vertebral compression fracture and vertebral augmentation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：76 歲女性，彎腰後急性下背痛 2 週，X 光示 L1 壓迫性骨折高度減少 30%，無神經症狀。本單元教評估與決策，不含骨水泥技術參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 76-year-old woman with 2 weeks of acute low back pain after bending, L1 compression fracture with 30% height loss, no neurological symptoms. Teaches assessment and decisions; no cement technique parameters.
